result.title: PRISM-AMC: Replay-Free Continual Learning for Automatic Modulation Classification
result.summary: Automatic modulation classification (AMC) is a key component of cognitive wireless systems, enabling spectrum awareness and adaptive communication. Most deep learning approaches to AMC assume a fixed set of modulation classes and access to previously observed training data. In practice, modulation classes and channel conditions may evolve over time, while storage or data-retention constraints may preclude replay of raw baseband I/Q samples. We propose PRISM-AMC, a replay-free continual learning framework that mitigates catastrophic forgetting by preserving task-relevant subspaces of intermediate representations via gradient projection memory. We further analyze projected stochastic-gradient updates under an SNR-dependent gradient-noise model. PRISM-AMC is evaluated in both class-incremental and domain-incremental settings. Experiments on the MIGOU and DeepSig 2018.01A datasets show substantially reduced forgetting relative to sequential fine-tuning and elastic weight consolidation, while remaining competitive with or outperforming replay-based RSD-AMC in class-incremental settings, without storing raw I/Q samples.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PRISM-AMC，一种无回放的持续学习框架，通过梯度投影记忆保留中间表示中与任务相关的子空间以缓解灾难性遗忘，并在与 SNR 相关的梯度噪声模型下分析投影随机梯度更新，在调制分类数据集上评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对中间表示做任务子空间投影、不重放原始数据」的训练机制，可能可供核查用于 LVR/VLM 多阶段训练中保护视觉证据相关子空间、避免能力被覆盖；但领域为无线信号分类，与视觉推理主线无直接关联。
